title: SharePoint: Viva Connections multi-home site management moves to the SharePoint admin center
summary: The briefing passes: the management move, licensing, automatic migration, rollout dates and documented controls are supported. Two minor corrections remain: complete the home-site creation route and remove the permissions check from the checklist because it has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center to the SharePoint admin center.
claims.quote: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) to the SharePoint Admin Center (SPAC).

claims.claim: The roadmap says administrators will create and manage multiple home sites in the SharePoint admin center.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed: one experience is covered by E, F or A licensing, while multiple experiences require Viva licensing.
claims.quote:
Users with a Microsoft 365 subscription (E, F, or A license) are limited to creating and using one experience.
If you want to create or use two or more experiences (up to 50), then every user in your tenant must have a Microsoft Viva Suite or Viva Communications and Communities license.

claims.claim: Set-SPOHomeSite -HomeSiteUrl <site URL> sets a SharePoint site as a home site.
claims.quote:
Use this cmdlet to set a SharePoint Site as a Home Site.
-HomeSiteUrl
Sets the URL of the site collection to be the home site.

claims.claim: Learn describes Set-SPOHomeSite as initially supporting a single home-site setup, with additional home sites managed in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Initially it will continue supporting a single SharePoint home site setup. Setting up more SharePoint home sites can be done in the MAC.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn says Remove-SPOHomeSite was not supported initially for customers with multiple home sites, while the Microsoft 365 admin center supported removal.
claims.quote: This command won't be supported initially for multiple SharePoint home sites customers, but the MAC will support this operation.

claims.claim: Whether Set-SPOHomeSite now adds a site to the new multi-home-site list is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Set-SPOHomeSite" "multiple" "home sites". Read set-up-admin-center and Set-SPOHomeSite reference; found the initial single-site limitation and future support statement, not confirmation of the new list's cmdlet support.

claims.claim: Set-SPOHomeSite documents a -DraftMode parameter.
claims.quote:
-DraftMode
Whether to set the home site to draft mode.

claims.claim: How -DraftMode relates to the retirement of draft management states is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "DraftMode" "retired" "home"; Viva Connections draft experiences upgraded full home sites draft mode retirement MC1457839. Read Set-SPOHomeSite, set-up-admin-center and MC1457839; no parameter-retirement mapping found.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The sources do not state the specific handling or resulting user visibility of draft-state experiences during automatic upgrade.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Connections draft experiences upgraded full home sites draft mode retirement MC1457839. Read MC1457839, roadmap record, set-up-admin-center and home-sites-improvements; automatic upgrade is stated but draft-specific visibility is not.

claims.claim: SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites > Add is the entry point for creating or adding a home site.
claims.quote:
Select Settings, and then select Home sites.
Select Add, and then select Create a new site.
Preview the Home site template, and then select Use template.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path to 'Settings > Home sites > Add > Create a new site > Use template > Create site'. Append to its note: 'For an existing site, use Settings > Home sites > Add > Use an existing communication site.' Apply the same routes in the rendered table. Both routes are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/homesites/set-up-admin-center.

claims.claim: The audience control is at SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites > home site > three dots menu > Edit audience.
claims.quote:
In Settings > Home sites, select the home site.
Select the three dots menu (...), and then select Edit audience.

claims.claim: The priority control is at SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites > Change order.
claims.quote:
In Settings > Home sites, select Change order.
Drag home sites into the order you want.

claims.claim: Removal is at SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites > home site > three dots menu > Remove as home site.
claims.quote:
In Settings > Home sites, select the three dots menu (...) for a home site.
Select Remove as home site. A confirmation panel opens.

In the SharePoint admin center, select Sites > Active sites, and then select the home site.

Select Settings to expand the selection and select Viva.

Select Create and manage Viva Connections experiences.
